_description: Spouse-owned Traditional account triggers RMD at spouse age 73 even though primary is only age 70. Two Traditional accounts: self-owned ($300k, no RMD until primary hits 73) and spouse-owned ($200k, RMD starts immediately). 0% return, no spending, MFJ filing with standard deduction covering the small RMD so no tax.
_rationale: Verifies per-owner RMD split. Year 0: primary=70 (no self RMD), spouse=73 → spouseRmd=200000/26.5=7547.17. Year 3: primary now 73 → both fire: selfRmd=300000/26.5=11320.75 plus spouseRmd from reduced spouse balance (~7484) for a combined ~18805.
name: RMD Spouse Owner
